summary.text: Kellie Streeter is the Republican candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 45 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as government administration.

paragraphs.text: Kellie Streeter earned a high school diploma from Apollo High School and a bachelor's degree from Kentucky Wesleyan College in 2004.

Her career experience includes government administration, and as of 2024 she was affiliated with the Indiana County Commissioners Association and the Association of Indiana Counties Board of Directors.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Streeter described herself as the administrator of the Daviess County Health Department and president of the Knox County Board of Commissioners, an office she first held after a caucus in 2016.
She said she is originally from rural Kentucky, lives in Freelandville, and serves as vice chair of the Knox County Republican Party.
Her stated priorities in that survey included protecting local control, agriculture and property rights, rural road and bridge funding, and rural healthcare.
